title: Yesu An Adwaro
stanzas: O Yesu, an adwaro Atini nyaka chieng` Asayi bedi buta, Ruodha ma jakonya.Ok analuor lwenj Satan ka In ibet buta; Yo maber ok aweyo ka In itelona.
Mondo ang`e in koda, Pinyni oywayoa;Aneno gik magombo, Dwonde matemoa; Wasika gi gilwora, Kendo gin e chunya; O Yesu, bi, ikonya, Mondo alo Satan.
O Yesu, isewacho duto molu bang`i, Ka ma intie e duong`ni Ginibedi bende.To Yesu, an adwaro Atini nyaka chieng`;Asayi konya pile, Ruodha ma Jawarna.
